_comment: Committed criterion baseline for hook_overhead::on_event_overhead (v0.5 Phase P). Read by ci/hook_benchmark.sh. mean_ns is the criterion mean point estimate (nanoseconds) measured on the machine that recorded this file; regression_factor is how many times slower a CI run may be before the gate fails, generous enough to absorb cross-machine noise while still catching a real regression. absolute_ceiling_ns is the hard PRD-001 N-01 target (<10us per hook round trip) and is checked independently of the recorded baseline.
